data.title: Grant of advance maintenance payment (Unterhaltsvorschuss) for Marie
data.summary: The Jugendamt / Unterhaltsvorschusskasse of Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück informs Annika Beispielsteiner that it will pay advance maintenance (Unterhaltsvorschuss) for her daughter Marie of €293.00 per month starting 1 November 2026, while pursuing the maintenance claim against the father itself. The letter also explains the right to file an objection (Widerspruch).
data.explanation: This letter confirms a benefit: the Jugendamt will pay €293.00 every month for Marie starting 1 November 2026, because it is claiming maintenance from her father on your behalf instead of you having to do so. You don't need to do anything to receive the payments, but you must tell the Jugendamt immediately if the father starts paying maintenance directly to you or if you move house, since this affects your entitlement. If you disagree with the decision (e.g. the amount), you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person; the app will show you the deadline. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the decision becomes final.

items.title: Receive advance maintenance payment (Unterhaltsvorschuss) for Marie
items.action: No action is needed; the Jugendamt will pay this amount automatically each month.
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marie zahlen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 Unterhaltsvorschuss nach dem Unterhaltsvorschussgesetz in Höhe von 293,00 € monatlich.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with this decision (e.g. the amount granted), file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Kreisverwaltung by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final (bestandskräftig) if no objection is filed in time.

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.

items.title: Report maintenance payments from the father or a change of address
items.action: Notify the Jugendamt immediately if Marie's father pays maintenance directly to you, or if you move to a new address.
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlt oder Sie umziehen.
